blocks.en: Section III: Common Changes to Glass Vials and Stoppers

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 FDA 如何利用 Appendix 表格整合現有指引的 CCS 變更建議
blocks.en: Understand how FDA uses the appendix tables to consolidate CCS change recommendations from existing guidances

blocks.zh: 掌握 confirmatory data（確認性數據）的定義及其在 CCS 變更評估中的角色
blocks.en: Master the definition of confirmatory data and its role in assessing CCS changes

blocks.zh: 了解多重同時變更 (concurrent changes) 的通報原則——以最高風險類別為準
blocks.en: Understand the reporting principle for concurrent changes: the highest-risk category governs

blocks.zh: 認識 CCS 變更連帶影響成品規格 (finished product specifications) 時的額外要求
blocks.en: Recognize the additional requirements when a CCS change also affects finished product specifications

blocks.zh: 理解 USP monograph 合規性在 CCS 組件變更中的法規意義
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory significance of USP monograph compliance for CCS component changes

blocks.en: III. Common Changes Related to Glass Vials and Stoppers

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Confirmatory Data (確認性數據)：這是 FDA 在 CCS 變更評估中要求的核心證據。確認性數據指的是比較性的批次數據——比較變更前後生產的產品，證明變更未對產品品質造成不良影響。這不是簡單的「通過測試」，而是要展示變更前後的一致性 (comparability)。
blocks.en: Confirmatory Data: This is the core evidence FDA expects in assessing a CCS change. Confirmatory data are comparative batch data: product made before and after the change is compared to show that the change has no adverse effect on product quality. This is not simply "passing the tests"; it means demonstrating comparability between the pre-change and post-change product.

blocks.zh: Body of Knowledge (知識基礎)：FDA 允許根據現有知識基礎來調整提交數據量。如果申請者已經累積了豐富的產品和 CCS 相容性數據（例如通過長期穩定性研究、多批次生產經驗），則可能需要較少的額外數據。這是 ICH Q12 中 Established Conditions 概念的延伸。
blocks.en: Body of Knowledge: FDA allows the amount of data submitted to be adjusted according to the existing body of knowledge. If the applicant has already accumulated extensive product and CCS compatibility data (for example, from long-term stability studies and experience with many batches), less additional data may be needed. This extends the concept of Established Conditions in ICH Q12.

blocks.zh: Cumulative Effect (累積效應)：當同時進行多個相關變更時，不能分別評估每個變更的風險，而要評估變更的累積影響。通報類別以最高風險的個別變更為準。
blocks.en: Cumulative Effect: When several related changes are made at the same time, the risk of each change cannot be assessed separately; the cumulative effect of the changes must be assessed. The reporting category is that of the highest-risk individual change.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 同時變更的「最高風險」原則就像機場安檢升級：如果你同時攜帶了筆電（一般安檢）和一瓶液體超過 100ml（加強安檢），你不能分開兩個通道處理——你必須走最嚴格的安檢通道。同理，如果你同時變更玻璃瓶供應商（可能是 AR）和瓶塞材料（PAS），整包 supplement 必須以 PAS 規格提交。
blocks.en: The "highest risk" principle for concurrent changes is like an upgrade in airport security: if you carry both a laptop (standard screening) and a bottle of liquid over 100 ml (enhanced screening), you cannot send the two items through separate lanes; you must go through the strictest lane. Likewise, if you change the glass vial supplier (possibly an AR) and the stopper material (PAS) at the same time, the whole supplement must be submitted at the PAS level.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: FDA CCS Guidance (1999) 的基礎角色：本 Guidance 的 Appendix 表格中推薦的數據類型，源自 1999 年的 Container Closure Systems for Packaging Human Drugs and Biologics 指引。該 1999 年指引至今仍是 FDA CCS 評估的基石文件。理解 1999 年指引中對 protection、safety、compatibility、performance 四個面向的評估框架，是正確使用本 2024 年 Guidance 的前提。
blocks.en: The foundational role of the FDA CCS Guidance (1999): The data types recommended in this guidance's appendix tables derive from the 1999 guidance Container Closure Systems for Packaging Human Drugs and Biologics. That 1999 guidance remains the cornerstone document for FDA's CCS assessment. Understanding its evaluation framework of protection, safety, compatibility, and performance is a prerequisite for using this 2024 guidance correctly.

blocks.zh: Tightening vs Widening Specifications：這是一個常被忽略的重要原則。收緊 (tightening) acceptance criteria（例如將微粒限度從 NMT 600 降至 NMT 300 個/container）通常被視為低風險變更，因為代表更嚴格的品質要求；而放寬 (widening)（例如從 NMT 300 升至 NMT 600 個/container）則是高風險，因為可能降低產品品質。
blocks.en: Tightening vs Widening Specifications: This is an important principle that is often overlooked. Tightening acceptance criteria (for example, reducing the particulate limit from NMT 600 to NMT 300 particles per container) is generally regarded as a low-risk change because it represents a stricter quality requirement, whereas widening (for example, from NMT 300 to NMT 600 particles per container) is high risk because it may lower product quality.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 與 SUPAC 指引的連結
blocks.en: Key Notes: Link to the SUPAC Guidances

blocks.zh: SUPAC 系列：Appendix 表格中推薦的批次數量（如 NDA/ANDA 1-3 批）源自 SUPAC (Scale-Up and Postapproval Changes) 系列指引的原則。SUPAC-IR（即釋製劑）和 SUPAC-SS（半固體製劑）雖然主要針對口服製劑，但其中的 CCS 變更通報原則也被本 Guidance 引用。對於注射劑，本 Guidance 的建議更為具體和嚴格。
blocks.en: The SUPAC series: The batch numbers recommended in the appendix tables (for example, 1-3 batches for NDA/ANDA) derive from the principles of the SUPAC (Scale-Up and Postapproval Changes) series of guidances. Although SUPAC-IR (immediate-release solid oral dosage forms) and SUPAC-SS (nonsterile semisolid dosage forms) target mainly oral products, this guidance also draws on their reporting principles for CCS changes. For injectables, the recommendations in this guidance are more specific and stricter.

blocks.zh: NDA/ANDA vs BLA 的差異：生物製品（BLA）的 CCS 變更通常比化學藥品（NDA/ANDA）要求更高的通報類別。這是因為生物製品（如蛋白質、抗體）對 CCS 組件的交互作用更敏感——例如，玻璃瓶溶出的金屬離子可能導致蛋白質聚集 (aggregation)。
blocks.en: NDA/ANDA vs BLA differences: CCS changes for biologics (BLA) generally call for a higher reporting category than those for chemical drugs (NDA/ANDA). This is because biologics (such as proteins and antibodies) are more sensitive to interactions with CCS components; for example, metal ions leached from glass vials may cause protein aggregation.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境 — Confirmatory Data 的準備：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: preparing confirmatory data

blocks.zh: 假設客戶的 NDA 產品需要從供應商 A 的 Type I 玻璃瓶切換到供應商 B。作為 CDMO，你需要準備的 confirmatory data 包括：
blocks.en: Suppose a client's NDA product needs to switch from supplier A's Type I glass vials to supplier B. As the CDMO, the confirmatory data you need to prepare include:

blocks.zh: 變更前數據 (Pre-change)：最近 3 批使用供應商 A 玻璃瓶的 release 和穩定性數據
blocks.en: Pre-change data: Release and stability data for the last 3 batches made with supplier A vials

blocks.zh: 變更後數據 (Post-change)：至少 1-3 批使用供應商 B 玻璃瓶的 release 和穩定性數據（加速 + 長期）
blocks.en: Post-change data: Release and stability data (accelerated plus long-term) for at least 1-3 batches made with supplier B vials

blocks.zh: 比較分析：展示變更前後的 CQA（如 pH、微粒、可見異物、含量、效價）無顯著差異
blocks.en: Comparative analysis: Demonstrate no significant difference in CQAs (such as pH, particulates, visible particles, assay, and potency) before and after the change

blocks.zh: CCIT 數據：Container Closure Integrity Testing 確認密封完整性
blocks.en: CCIT data: Container closure integrity testing to confirm seal integrity

blocks.zh: 時程規劃提示：加速穩定性數據至少需要 3 個月，長期數據需要 12-24 個月。因此，CCS 供應商變更計畫應提前 1-2 年啟動。
blocks.en: Timeline planning tip: Accelerated stability data take at least 3 months, and long-term data take 12-24 months. A CCS supplier change plan should therefore start 1-2 years ahead.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Labeling 合規性
blocks.en: Practical Application: Labeling Compliance

blocks.zh: 標示變更的連鎖效應：如果你的產品標示寫 "packaged in Type I glass"，而新的 CCS 組件屬於不同 type/grade，除了 CCS 變更的 supplement 外，還需要另一個 labeling supplement。同時，如果新組件與 USP monograph 中規定的不同，可能需要與 USP 協商更新 monograph。
blocks.en: The knock-on effect of labeling changes: If your product labeling states "packaged in Type I glass" and the new CCS component is a different type or grade, a separate labeling supplement is needed in addition to the CCS change supplement. Also, if the new component differs from what the USP monograph specifies, you may need to work with USP to update the monograph.

blocks.zh: 這對 CDMO 的啟示：在協助客戶評估 CCS 變更時，務必同步檢查產品標示和 USP monograph 的合規性，避免遺漏附加的法規提交。
blocks.en: Implication for CDMOs: when helping a client assess a CCS change, always check product labeling and USP monograph compliance at the same time, so that no additional regulatory submission is missed.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的客戶同時要變更玻璃瓶供應商（無組成變化，建議 AR）和瓶塞尺寸（建議 CBE-30）。正確的提交方式是什麼？為什麼不能分開提交兩個不同類別的 supplement？
blocks.en: Your client wants to change the glass vial supplier (no composition change; AR suggested) and the stopper size (CBE-30 suggested) at the same time. What is the correct way to submit? Why can the two supplements of different categories not be submitted separately?

blocks.zh: "Body of knowledge" 如何實際運用？舉例說明一個擁有豐富知識基礎的產品和一個新核准產品，在 CCS 變更時需要的數據量差異。
blocks.en: How is the "body of knowledge" applied in practice? Give an example of the difference in data volume needed for a CCS change between a product with an extensive body of knowledge and a newly approved product.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 confirmatory data 必須是「比較性」數據？只提交變更後的批次數據（顯示符合規格）是否足夠？
blocks.en: Why must confirmatory data be "comparative"? Is it sufficient to submit only post-change batch data showing compliance with specifications?

blocks.zh: Tightening vs widening specifications 的原則如何應用到 CCS 變更後的微粒限度 (particulate matter limits)？請以具體數字舉例。
blocks.en: How does the principle of tightening vs widening specifications apply to particulate matter limits after a CCS change? Illustrate with specific numbers.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Appendix 表格是核心工具：整合了多份 FDA 指引中關於 CCS 變更的通報類別和所需數據的建議，是 CDMO 日常查閱的關鍵參考
blocks.en: The appendix tables are the core tool: They consolidate recommendations from multiple FDA guidances on reporting categories and required data for CCS changes, and are a key reference for CDMOs in daily work

blocks.zh: Confirmatory Data 的定義：變更前後的比較性批次數據，足以證明 CCS 變更未對產品品質造成不良影響
blocks.en: Definition of confirmatory data: Comparative batch data from before and after the change, sufficient to show that the CCS change has no adverse effect on product quality

blocks.zh: 同時變更採最高風險類別：多個相關變更同時進行時，必須評估累積效應，並以最高風險的個別變更類別提交 supplement
blocks.en: Concurrent changes follow the highest-risk category: When several related changes are made together, the cumulative effect must be assessed and the supplement submitted under the category of the highest-risk individual change

blocks.zh: 規格變更的連動效應：CCS 變更如連帶影響成品規格，必須同時提交支持數據；收緊規格通常較寬鬆規格需要更低的通報類別
blocks.en: Knock-on effects of specification changes: If a CCS change also affects finished product specifications, supporting data must be submitted at the same time; tightening a specification generally warrants a lower reporting category than widening it

blocks.zh: 標示與藥典合規：CCS 變更可能連帶需要標示變更和 USP monograph 更新，CDMO 應協助客戶全面評估法規影響
blocks.en: Labeling and compendial compliance: A CCS change may also require a labeling change and a USP monograph update, and the CDMO should help the client assess the full regulatory impact

blocks.zh: 數據量視知識基礎而定：NDA/ANDA 1-3 批，BLA 依產品特性可能更多；申請者可聯繫 FDA 獲取具體數據量建議
blocks.en: Data volume depends on the body of knowledge: 1-3 batches for NDA/ANDA, and possibly more for BLA depending on product characteristics; applicants may contact FDA for specific recommendations on data volume
